notes: FirstSeen Desktop V10.2.8 bundles Browser CRM V2.3. The left-side cold-call script is now directly editable during a call. Buttons at the bottom let you Save for the prospect, Save for all prospects, or Don't save. Prospect-only saves persist just for that lead; Save for all prospects stores the edited script as the default while still substituting each lead's business name, call reason and website issue. Desktop-connected script preferences persist in the existing SQLite app_settings table. Existing Twilio calling, outcomes, follow-ups, Finder shortlist, live SQLite CRM data and updater behaviour are preserved.
